svg.title: MultiplexConsumer is new lifecycle glue
svg.desc: The new tidy listener uses the existing beforeExecute hook to add the original and deferred tidy consumers. The beforeExecute hook loop and Execute() stay unchanged; the listener adds the consumer wrapper. The specialized multiplexer initializes only the new tidy child; matching itself remains deferred.
svg.text: The new tidy listener uses the existing beforeExecute hook to add the original and deferred tidy consumers.
